name: Arcane Waterworks
description: The Arcane Waterworks regulate Ka Vethan’s water supply through void‑arcane filtration, Luclinite purification, and resonance‑flow engineering. Crystal conduits channel purified water throughout the city, while void‑tainted runoff is neutralized in containment chambers. Akhevan engineers maintain the Waterworks with precision, ensuring the city’s infrastructure remains stable.
